description: Unique WG record ID; links the row to its screening record. Assigned sequentially, never reused.
allowed_values: NAMWG-#### (4 digits)

description: Stable identifier of the reference: PubMed ID if available; otherwise DOI; otherwise a stable URL (e.g., regulatory guidance).
allowed_values: PMID: <digits>; DOI: <doi>; URL

description: WG member adding the entry.
allowed_values: Krina Mehta; Khem Raj Ghusinga; Jason Sherfey; Ben Knapp; Lara Clemens; Celeste Vallejo; Christina Battista; Christian Maass; Mokshada Kumar; Other

description: Full title of the reference.
allowed_values: free text

description: Publication year.
allowed_values: YYYY

description: Type of report. Only 'Primary research' rows count in the evidence map; all other types are context references.
allowed_values: Primary research; Review; Perspective; Guidance/regulatory; Workshop report; Database/resource

description: How the record was identified (used for the PRISMA-ScR flow).
allowed_values: Database search; Seed; Citation search; Member nomination; Grey literature

description: WG workstream(s) the record informs. Multiple allowed. WS2 = complex in vitro systems + mechanistic models; WS3 = platform mechanistic models as in silico NAMs; WS4 = multimodal data / ML + mechanistic.
allowed_values: WS2; WS3; WS4

description: Broad NAM category. Multiple allowed (e.g., in vitro data integrated with an in silico model). Use 'Policy/Framework' for references whose main content is regulatory policy, guidance, qualification pathways, roadmaps or adoption strategy rather than a specific method.
allowed_values: In vitro; In silico; In chemico; Hybrid (in vitro + in silico); Policy/Framework; Other

description: Specific system(s) and/or model type(s). Multiple allowed, separated by '; '. Controlled terms ONLY - no parenthetical text; put platform/assay details in system_details.
allowed_values: In vitro: Standard 2D/primary cells; Organoid; Microphysiological system (MPS); Organ-on-chip; Spheroid/3D culture; Other in vitro. In silico: QSP; QST; PBPK; PK/PD; ML/AI; Hybrid ML-mechanistic; QSAR; Other in silico

description: Free-text details of the in vitro system and/or model: cell sources, platform, readouts, model specifics.
allowed_values: free text
example: Organ-on-chip: gut/liver/kidney vascularized chips; PBPK: chip data scaled to physiological PK model

description: Commercial platform or vendor of the in vitro system, if any. Multiple allowed.
allowed_values: Emulate; CN Bio; Mimetas; InSphero; TissUse; Academic/custom; Other; Not reported

description: Organ, tissue, or system of focus. Use 'Multi-organ' or 'Not organ-specific' if applicable.
allowed_values: free text

description: Context of use: what question or decision the NAM informs. Start with a category, then a short statement after a colon.
allowed_values: <category>: <statement>, where category is PK/exposure; Efficacy; Safety - acute; Safety - chronic; Target/mechanism; Dose selection; Policy/Framework; Other
example: Safety - chronic: predict clinical hepatotoxicity risk to prioritize candidates before FIH

description: Development stage at which the approach was applied. Multiple allowed.
allowed_values: Discovery; Lead optimization; IND-enabling; FIH; Phase 2/3; Post-marketing; Regulatory review; Not applicable

description: Whether the work informed an actual decision.
allowed_values: Prospective decision; Retrospective/benchmark only; Regulatory interaction; None/not reported

description: How the in vitro readout is carried to an in vivo/human prediction. Multiple allowed.
allowed_values: Direct/physiological scaling; IVIVE; PBPK-linked exposure; QSP/QST calibration; PK/PD linkage; ML/statistical; Other

description: Therapeutic area(s). Multiple allowed.
allowed_values: Oncology; I&I; Rare disease; Neuroscience; Metabolic; Cardiovascular; Infectious disease; Agnostic; Other

description: Drug modality. Multiple allowed.
allowed_values: Small molecule; Biologic (mAb/protein); ADC; Oligonucleotide; Cell/gene therapy; Peptide; Other

description: Number of compounds evaluated.
allowed_values: integer

description: How the NAM's predictions were evaluated. Multiple allowed; add details (e.g., V&V40 or ICH M15 framework, number of compounds) in contributor_comments.
allowed_values: Compared with clinical data; Compared with in vivo animal data; Compared with other in vitro data; Internal/cross-validation only; Uncertainty/sensitivity analysis; Formal credibility framework; Regulatory acceptance; Not reported
example: Compared with clinical data; Uncertainty/sensitivity analysis

description: Performance metric(s) reported against the benchmark. Multiple allowed; give values in contributor_comments.
allowed_values: AFE; % within 2-fold; R2; AUROC; HR/OR; Qualitative; Other; Not reported

description: FDA NAM validation principles (Mar 2026 draft guidance) explicitly addressed. Multiple allowed.
allowed_values: Context of use; Human biological relevance; Technical characterization; Fit-for-purpose; None stated
example: Context of use; Human biological relevance

description: 3Rs impact claimed or shown.
allowed_values: Replace; Reduce; Refine; None; Not discussed

description: Whether data and/or code are publicly available.
allowed_values: Data; Code; Both; Neither

description: Whether the row was charted from the full text (Y) or from the abstract only (N).
allowed_values: Y; N

description: Charting status. Only 'Verified' rows are used in the analysis.
allowed_values: Draft; Verified

description: Second WG member who checked the row against the full text.
allowed_values: WG member name (same list as contributor)

description: Short summary of the system/approach and key findings in your own words, plus relevance to the WG, gaps or challenges, case-study potential, and anything else worth noting.
allowed_values: free text
